profile.site: land next to JERA's Chiba Thermal Power Station, east of Tokyo
profile.power: behind the meter from the adjacent gas fired plant, up to 400 MW under a 15 to 25 year agreement with JERA
profile.roles: JERA provides land and power; RHAELM develops, builds, operates and finances; Dell supplies standardised rack scale AI infrastructure; Apollo Global Management is RHAELM's strategic investment and financial partner

sources.title: $140B and 3–4 GW: Japan Is Planning AI Data Centers at National Scale
Japan eyes $140bn AI data centre push with Dell and JERA, FT reports
Japan AI Data Center Push Could Reach $140B as Dell, JERA Start $15B Build

profile.schedule: phased operations targeted from 2028, full 400 MW in 2029
profile.programme: a repeatable model for several gigawatts of AI data centre capacity across JERA power sites in Japan in the 2030s; the Financial Times reported the wider effort could reach about $140 billion, a figure JERA's own announcement does not state
profile.capacity_note: Figures are from an announcement, not from an operator specification or a filing. Announced capacity is a plan. Investment is not capacity and neither is floor area.
profile.research_note: [2026-10-01, editor] Added at Stephen's request from the datacenters.com article and corroborating reports. Every figure as stated in the cited reports; the article itself named no companies. Coordinates not set. Status is announced, not operating.
profile.investment_as_stated: more than US$15 billion (2.3 trillion yen) across all phases
